7753.title: Synchronous SQLite waits and planner statistics
7753.rootCauseOneLine: Synchronous SQLite lock waits block the event loop; fresh databases lack planner statistics, but the closest current turn-item lookup already pins the correct index.
7753.proposedFix: Capture a real current-main stall on a sanitized database copy before choosing a statistics-maintenance or I/O-isolation design; no safe simple fix is isolated.
7753.caveats: Repeated synthetic writer-lock and planner diagnostics, not the reported 62-second large-database stalls or disconnects; bounded analysis succeeds here; current query already has an index hint.
